Name: Soshistyle's rosy reshade
Author: soshistyle
Description:
This is a reshade preset. U need reshade software to use it
- choose StardewModdingAPI.exe when selecting the game
- choose openGL
- choose the option where u will update both reshade and effects
- upload this preset to upload its effects 
- open the game
- done!

Downloads.Description: unzip it save wherever and memorize it wherever u saved it.
